from scipy.optimize import least_squares
def fit(f,p0):
    best=None
    for s in [1,0.3,3]:
        try:
            r=least_squares(lambda p: f(p)-dP_dt, np.array(p0)*s if s!=1 else p0, max_nfev=2000)
            v=np.var(r.fun)/np.var(dP_dt)
            if best is None or v<best[0]: best=(v,np.round(r.x,4))
        except Exception as e: pass
    return best
